referenceSources.title: 1986 Ferrari 288 GTO Evoluzione - price and specifications
referenceSources.description:
The 1986 Ferrari 288 GTO Evoluzione stands out with its vivid red paint, wide rear fenders, and large adjustable rear wing. Its louvered engine cover and side vents underscore the car’s race-bred heritage, while polished multi-piece wheels complete the aggressive look. Parked on a smooth asphalt surface, the supercar’s aerodynamic enhancements and sculpted bodywork are on full display.

Under the hood, the Evoluzione is powered by a 2.9‑liter twin‑turbo V8 producing 650 hp, enabling a top speed of 370 km/h (230 mph) and a 0–100 km/h sprint in 4.1 seconds. Weighing 1114 kg, it achieves a power-to-weight ratio of 584 hp per tonne. Priced around $2 million, this limited-run model represents one of Ferrari’s most extreme homologation specials, bridging the gap between road car and track weapon.
